clickfeeder.settings.title: ClickFeeder Settings
clickfeeder.settings.feedRadius.tooltip: Search distance in blocks. Animals must still be visible and within normal interaction reach.
clickfeeder.settings.maxFeedsPerClick.to: Maximum number of animals to feed with one click.
clickfeeder.settings.switchHotbar.toolti: Use matching food from other hotbar slots.
clickfeeder.settings.restockInventory.to: Move matching food from your inventory into the selected hotbar slot when needed.
clickfeeder.settings.feedBabies.tooltip: Allow food to be used to speed up baby animal growth.
clickfeeder.settings.sneakBypass.tooltip: Hold sneak to use food normally without nearby feeding.
